attacks.name: Hammer Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the target character is Size 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Lightning Blast
steps: |!wild| |*Electric Shock|: Before |!damage| is dealt, all other characters within |!range| 2 of the target character suffer 2 |!damage|.
After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

superPowers.name: Renegade Thor of Asgardia (Affiliation: Asgard)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, when an allied character attacks an enemy character within |!range| 2 of itself, the allied character may reroll 1 of its attack dice.|\|Additionally, once per Turn, when an enemy character targets an allied character with an attack, if the enemy character is not within |!range| 2 of it, the allied character may reroll 1 of its defense dice.

superPowers.name: For Midgard!
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character makes a move action followed by an attack action. When making this attack, this character may reroll up to two of its dice. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Inner Strength
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of Size 4 or less within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: If She be Worthy
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, during the |*Modify Dice| step, it may use this superpower. This character may reroll any number of its defense dice.

superPowers.name: Blessed by the All-Mother
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
